annotations.description: Scrapes have failed for 30 minutes. Check the target error in Prometheus, NetworkPolicies, routing, TLS and endpoint health. Job={{ $labels.job }}, endpoint={{ $labels.endpoint }}, path={{ $labels.metrics_path }}.

rules.expr:
group by (job, namespace, service, node, endpoint, metrics_path) (present_over_time(up[24h]))
unless
group by (job, namespace, service, node, endpoint, metrics_path) (up)

annotations.description: A scrape group seen in the last 24 hours has been absent for 30 minutes. Check ServiceMonitor/PodMonitor/ScrapeConfig discovery and endpoints. This can also indicate intentional removal; it expires after the 24-hour history window. Pod/instance labels are ignored to tolerate replacements. Stable node labels are retained where the scraper supplies them.
No healthy target for required job kubelet for 30 minutes, including when discovery returns no targets. Check discovery, NetworkPolicies and node endpoints.
No healthy target for required job node-exporter for 30 minutes, including when discovery returns no targets. Check discovery, NetworkPolicies and node endpoints.
No healthy target for required job etcd for 30 minutes, including when discovery returns no targets. Check discovery, NetworkPolicies and node endpoints.
